story.iWant: new knowledge generated during conversations automatically compiled into the wiki and graph
story.soThat: insights, decisions, and discoveries from conversations don't get lost

task.title: Implement NEW_KNOWLEDGE block parser
task.subtask: Create a parser function in /home/ubuntu/scripts/lib/knowledge-parser.mjs that extracts structured knowledge items from agent output
Parse the YAML-like format within ---NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- / ---END_NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- delimiters
Validate each extracted item has required fields (type, title, content)
Return an array of parsed knowledge items or empty array if no block found

task.title: Implement knowledge type to phase directory mapping
task.subtask: Define the mapping: decision to knowledge/decisions/, insight to knowledge/discovery/, requirement to knowledge/requirements/, risk to knowledge/planning/
Generate article slugs from titles: lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens, remove special characters
Handle slug collisions by appending a numeric suffix
Construct the full file path: {knowledgeDir}/{phaseDir}/{slug}.md

task.title: Create wiki articles from knowledge items
task.subtask: Generate frontmatter: title, type, phase, status: active, maturity: 0.3, created/updated timestamps, tags
Write the article body with Purpose section (from content field)
Add Dependencies section with [[wikilinks]] from the links field
Write the article to the appropriate phase directory on disk

task.title: Integrate with graph-sync for embedding and Memgraph upsert
task.subtask: After writing all new articles, call graph-sync.mjs --project {{projectId}} --knowledge-dir {{knowledgeDir}}
graph-sync.mjs will detect the new articles via content hash comparison and process them (embed + upsert)
Verify new nodes appear in Memgraph with correct embeddings and edge connections

task.title: Update log.md and index.md
task.subtask: Append an entry to knowledge/log.md with timestamp, source conversation ID, and list of created articles
Update knowledge/index.md catalog to include the new articles
Include the pipeline job ID / conversation ID in the log entry for traceability

task.title: Wire compilation step into conversation pipeline
task.subtask: Add the compile-conversation step to the conversation pipeline definition (after the respond step)
Make the step conditional — only runs if NEW_KNOWLEDGE was extracted from the agent's response
Add the sync shell step after compilation to trigger graph-sync.mjs
Test the full flow: conversation to knowledge extraction to article creation to embedding to Memgraph sync

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: When a conversation pipeline completes and the agent produced a ---NEW_KNOWLEDGE--- block, the compilation step runs automatically
Each knowledge item is created as a wiki article in the appropriate phase directory (knowledge/{phase}/)
The article type matches the knowledge type: decision to decisions/, insight to discovery/, requirement to requirements/, risk to planning/
[[wikilinks]] are created in the new article to the related articles mentioned in the links field of the knowledge block
The new article is embedded via Voyage AI and synced to Memgraph via graph-sync.mjs
knowledge/log.md records the conversation-derived compilation with a timestamp and source conversation ID

constraints.constraint: Generated articles must follow the standard wiki format: YAML frontmatter (title, type, phase, status, maturity, created, updated, tags) followed by Purpose, Dependencies sections
Conversation-derived knowledge starts at maturity 0.3 (low) because it is informal and may need validation
decision -> knowledge/decisions/, insight -> knowledge/discovery/, requirement -> knowledge/requirements/, risk -> knowledge/planning/
Slug collision handling must append numeric suffix to avoid overwriting existing articles
log.md entries must include pipeline job ID / conversation ID for audit trail
Compilation step only runs if NEW_KNOWLEDGE block was extracted; pipeline should complete normally if no new knowledge was produced
